tasks.gr11-development-indicators-t3: Topic: Development Indicators and the Development Gap. Cover GDP, GNP, GDP per capita, the Human Development Index (HDI) and its three components, social indicators (infant mortality, literacy, life expectancy), Rostow's stages of development, and the causes of the development gap. Ask Grade 11 learners to interpret an HDI ranking table, compare social indicators between countries, or explain why GDP alone is an inadequate measure of development.
tasks.gr11-trade-globalisation-t3: Topic: International Trade and Globalisation. Cover the balance of trade, comparative advantage, free trade vs protectionism (tariffs, quotas, subsidies), the role of the WTO, transnational corporations (TNCs), and the effects of globalisation on developing countries including debt, brain drain, and fair trade. Ask Grade 11 learners to explain the difference between a trade surplus and deficit, evaluate the benefits and drawbacks of globalisation for South Africa, or describe how TNCs operate.
tasks.gr11-aid-gender-development-t3: Topic: Aid, Gender, and Development. Cover bilateral, multilateral, and NGO aid; problems with aid (dependency, tied aid, conditionality); the role of gender equality in development (Gender Development Index, women in food production); the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs); and African development challenges. Ask Grade 11 learners to distinguish between types of aid, explain why gender equality promotes development, or evaluate the progress toward a specific SDG.
tasks.gr11-state-business-roles-t3: Topic: Roles of the State and Business in Development. Cover government development policies (South Africa's NDP), public infrastructure investment, Foreign Direct Investment (FDI), Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs), Special Economic Zones, and the role of regional bodies (SADC, AU, BRICS) in Africa's development. Ask Grade 11 learners to explain how FDI supports economic development, describe a PPP case study, or evaluate BRICS's role in South Africa's economy.
tasks.gr11-development-factors-t3: Topic: Factors that affect development (Grade 11 Geography, Term 3). Cover access to resources, energy, history, trade imbalances, population growth (rule of 70), education and training, natural resource limits and environmental degradation, and how the factors are inter-related. Give all figures in the question.
tasks.gr11-development-models-t3: Topic: Development models (Grade 11 Geography, Term 3). Cover Rostow's five stages with limitations and criticisms, core and periphery models at global, national and local scales (spread and backwash effects), and the sustainability model with its economic, social and environmental elements.
tasks.gr11-community-based-development-t3: Topic: Community-based development (Grade 11 Geography, Term 3). Cover top-down and bottom-up approaches, rural and urban community projects, and examples from around the world (Grameen Bank, Green Belt Movement). Give all numbers in the question.
tasks.gr11-using-atlases-t3: Topic: Using atlases (Grade 11 Geography, Term 3). Cover kinds of atlas maps (physical, political, thematic), comparing and cross-referencing thematic maps, map projections (equal-area and true-direction, examples and limitations), the atlas index, alphanumeric references and latitude and longitude in degrees and minutes.
